name: Browser Back Button
description: Provides a placeable block that renders a clickable Back control; clicking it runs window.history.back() in the browser.
project_description: Browser Back Button ships a single custom block, "Browser Back Button Block", that you place through the standard Block Layout UI. The block renders a wrapper element containing admin-configured text or an image (entered through a text_format field), and attaches a small jQuery behavior so that clicking the block triggers the browser's native history.back(). The block's label for the back control is configurable per block placement. The module adds no routes, permissions, services, or dedicated settings form of its own — all configuration is done inside the block's own configure form under Block Layout. Core requirement is ^8 || ^9 || ^10 || ^11 and it has no module dependencies.
